title: LevelConfig
description: Схема конфигурации уровня и боевых волн для тактического экшена

prep_phase_duration.description: Длительность начальной подготовки к обороне в секундах

wave_rest_duration.description: Длительность передышки между волнами в секундах

cold_rate_mult.description: UE: level-wide multiplier of the cold accumulation (exploration and fights), multiplied with the wave cold_drain_mult / camera zones; 1 = unchanged

horde_enabled.description: UE: орда после 4 минут боя в реальном времени (Content/Data/AI/horde.json); false — выключить на этом уровне

ambush_fight.description: UE (2026-10-21): a fight with the level's placed enemies - level: all of them are the fight (wave panel after it); skirmish: only the enemies that spotted / attack the squad (+ escort / leader) fight, the others keep patrolling, no wave banner, straight back to exploration when they are down

susanin_wave.description: UE (2026-10-21): the wave of the Susanin rescue event; 0 = never on this level; absent = random among waves 1-3 (Godot)

gate_open_mode.description: UE: blast gate — generator_waves: the terminal only unlocks the servos, the door creeps open during the wave fight only while the generator works and opens fully after the final wave is cleared; instant: the terminal opens it at once

gate_progress_per_second.description: UE: door progress (0..1) per second of wave fight with the generator up (0.004 = 0.4 %/s)

gate_max_progress_before_final.description: UE: most the door reaches before the final wave is cleared; wave N of F may push it to this * N / F (3 waves: 30/60/90 %)

gate_full_open_after_wave.description: UE: the wave whose clearing opens the door fully; 0 = the level's last wave

gate_exit.description: UE (2026-10-22): the level ends with a fade to black once every living operative has left through the FULLY opened blast gate (the first AGateActor that is not set dressing). auto = out is the side away from the CombatStart point; +x / -x = the gate actor's local axis; object form tunes the fade (2 s), the return to the main menu (6 s, 0 = stay) and, when Content/Data/Campaign/campaign.json lists a next level, the seconds on the black screen before the stat-points screen / the next level (3 s, 0 = stay)

intro_dialogue.description: UE (2026-10-22 d): false = no intro briefing window / radio line at the mission start of this level (Frozen Factory drops the MovementTest briefing); a demo block's own intro_dialogue still applies

start_fade_seconds.description: UE (2026-10-22 b): the level starts on a black screen with its campaign title that fades in over this many real seconds (0 = no fade; a campaign arrival always fades in, 1.5 s)

horde.description: UE: переопределения horde.json для уровня (trigger_seconds, repeats, repeat_seconds, count, count_increase_per_repeat, composition, min_distance_m, max_distance_m, cluster_radius_m, prefer_out_of_sight, spawn_samples, apply_wave_modifiers, warning_seconds, warning_sound)

minimap.description: UE (2026-10-18, docs/design/MINIMAP.md): floors_cm = world Z (cm) of each UPPER floor's walking surface (absent = auto-detected); bounds_cm = [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] of the mapped area (absent = the navmesh bounds volumes)

environment.description: UE (2026-10-22, docs/systems/environment-weather.md): the day cycle / weather start of this level. locked: clock and weather never move (Demo 01 tutorial: Night + Snowfall); start_hour / weather: used when the level is locked or when there is no previous level to continue (every later level CONTINUES the time and weather where the previous one ended); seed: fixed weather RNG seed for a fresh start (0 / absent = random)

weather.description: The ladder state (Clear / Overcast / Snowfall / Blizzard); a temperate level (climate) also takes Sunny / SunnyDay (= Clear), Rain (= Snowfall), Storm (= Blizzard)

climate.description: Section 17 (user decision 2026-10-26): the climate profile. arctic = the whole game (winter ladder, snow, cold); temperate = a narrative level with a sunny day / overcast / rain / storm on the same ladder, no snow growth, mild cold (environment.json temperate), wetness and puddles. A level entered from a level of another climate starts its weather over (the time of day continues)

wetness.description: Section 17 (temperate): the start wetness of the ground when the level is locked or starts fresh for its climate; absent = environment.json temperate.start_wetness_<rain|storm> in rain / storm, else 0

puddles.description: Section 17 (temperate): the start puddle amount (same rule as wetness)

visuals.description: Environment phase 3: the weather presenter drives the lighting (sun / moon / sky light / fog / post-process by hour and weather; volumetric clouds off); false = the map's authored lighting stays

snow_cover.description: Environment phase 4: the start snow cover (0 bare .. 1 fully white) when the level is locked or starts fresh (no previous level to continue); absent = environment.json snow_cover_start. It grows while it snows and never recedes

environment_lock.description: Weather / time-of-day roster never changes this entry (Wave Editor row lock; EnvironmentRosterRules)
